key_insight: Mixture of Feature Difference (MoFD) synthesizes contrast-enhanced brain MRI from non-contrast sequences by adaptively combining sequence features and their differences.
clinical_relevance: This imaging research, not drug discovery, could potentially reduce contrast-agent exposure and scan costs while supporting brain tumor assessment.
method: Extract features from multiple non-contrast MRI sequences.
Dynamically weight individual features and explicit inter-sequence differences.
Compare adversarial and regression-based synthesis variants.
evidence_signal: On UCSF-PDGM and UPenn-GBM, the method outperformed baselines in image fidelity and perceptual quality, with tumor segmentation performance reported as comparable to real contrast-enhanced MRI.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish prospective clinical reliability, so synthetic images should not be assumed interchangeable with acquired contrast-enhanced MRI.
paper_title: Mixture of Multi-Sequence Feature Difference for Contrast-Enhanced MRI Synthesis
